formula: round(parking*0.20 + baby*0.20 + beauty*0.15 + food*0.15 + walking*0.10 + safety*0.10 + travel_effort*0.10)

destinations.name: Parco Giardino Sigurtà and Borghetto sul Mincio
destinations.explanation: Parking is named, close, and usually free at the garden. The park was built for slow walking: shade, toilets, lawns, a panoramic train if anyone is tired. Borghetto is a 20-minute postcard, not a hike. Tortellini di Valeggio is the best lunch of the week. Travel is ~28 minutes inland, away from SR249 harbor jams. Beauty is river-and-garden rather than famous-castle, which is the point.
destinations.why_suitable: This family gets beauty, food, and baby logistics without fighting a ZTL.
destinations.why_not_suitable: If they refuse to leave the lake shoreline even for three hours — still go; it is the highest score.

destinations.name: Lake Garda ferry loop (Bardolino–Garda–Torri)
destinations.explanation: Car stays in Bardolino (parking 95, effort 95). The lake is the scenery. Baby score is 80 not 95 because boarding gaps, sun, and possible swell — solved with a carrier and a short timetable, not a Riva odyssey. Walking is harbor-scale. Food is good if you step off the first pier menu.
destinations.why_suitable: Mandatory water experience that respects the 18:00 rule and an infant nap.
destinations.why_not_suitable: Storm days — use the land backup.

destinations.name: Peschiera del Garda
destinations.explanation: Beaches are the family's #1 priority and this is the easiest proper swim-and-stroll town that is still a day trip. Fortress walls are flat enough. Parking is not Sirmione. 20 minutes door to walls. Beauty is military-picturesque rather than dreamy, which is why it is 78 not 95 — honesty, not a penalty.
cons: Overlap with the Venice parking town — different day, different use
destinations.why_suitable: Converts 'we want a beach' into a loop with shade, toilets, and a named lot.
destinations.why_not_suitable: Do not combine with the Venice train morning.

destinations.name: Lazise
destinations.explanation: A lovely harbor 12 minutes south. High effort score because it is easy. Slightly lower parking than Peschiera's fortress lots. The hidden cost is sameness: it is Bardolino's cousin. Ranked below Peschiera because the family already lives in an east-shore harbor town and asked for beaches + a sense of going somewhere.
destinations.why_suitable: Emergency easy day if Peschiera is event-packed.
destinations.why_not_suitable: As a headline trip it under-delivers distinctness.

destinations.name: Torri del Benaco (by car)
destinations.explanation: Strong town, weaker than taking the ferry there. Driving north on SR249 spends parking luck you do not need to spend. Scored for completeness; the ferry composite already captures the right version of Torri.
cons: Duplicates the ferry day if both selected
destinations.why_suitable: If boats are cancelled, drive this instead of inventing Malcesine.
destinations.why_not_suitable: Do not pick as trip 3/4 if the ferry day already includes Torri.

destinations.name: Garda and Punta San Vigilio
destinations.explanation: Beauty almost maxes. Parking at the bay is the tax (48). That 20% weight hurts, correctly. A weekday dawn attempt can work; a scored headline trip cannot pretend the lot is easy.
destinations.why_suitable: Optional add-on from Garda if the ferry lands there and a taxi is sane — not a fourth trip.

destinations.name: Desenzano del Garda
destinations.explanation: Competent larger town. Loses to Peschiera on effort and to Sigurtà on baby/parking/food identity. Fine rainy cafe town, not a top-four winner.
cons: Longer drive around the lake foot
destinations.why_not_suitable: Does not beat Peschiera on this family's weights.

destinations.name: Salò
destinations.explanation: Elegant west shore. Travel effort 62 because you either drive around or involve the car traghetto. With a 6-month-old, that logistics tax is real. Food and promenade are excellent and still not enough to beat inland Sigurtà or east-shore Peschiera.
destinations.why_suitable: A future trip without an infant.

destinations.name: Riva del Garda
destinations.explanation: Head of the lake is a different climate and a long car. Against the spirit of 'approximately 2 hours' on a bad day. Wind-sport energy is the opposite of a newborn nap.

destinations.name: Verona
destinations.explanation: Food and beauty are high. Baby and walking take the hit: cobbles, ZTL, Romeo-and-Juliet crush. Keep as the indoor rainy nuclear option, not as a scored fourth trip.

destinations.name: Malcesine
destinations.explanation: Postcard famous. Cable car and castle queues are anti-infant. Parking and hills hurt. Local expert already substituted Torri.

destinations.name: Sirmione
destinations.explanation: Parking is 28 because the peninsula is a ZTL with lots that die by 10:00 and a Colombare backup that adds a long walk. That 20% weight is doing its job. Beauty cannot outvote a garage queue when the user listed parking as very important and a newborn is in the back seat. Grotte di Catullo would make walking worse; we already assumed they skip it.
cons: Long peninsula if you chase beaches
destinations.why_suitable: A child-free couple who loves leaving at 07:00.
destinations.why_not_suitable: This family. Do not add it because people expect it.

destinations.name: Venice
destinations.explanation: Scored honestly on the winning access mode (Peschiera train), not on a fantasy vaporetto from the apartment. Parking 70 is Peschiera station, not Tronchetto. Baby 45 and walking 35 are the bridges. Beauty 95 is deserved. Effort 40 is a long, early day. Total 63 would not win a fair fight — it is mandatory anyway. Do not inflate it.
pros: Infant usually free on regional trains
destinations.why_suitable: They asked for Venice. The train plan makes it survivable.
destinations.why_not_suitable: Without a carrier, or if trains are on strike — then skip, do not drive the lagoon as a 'fix'.

destinations.name: Cisano / Bardolino beaches
destinations.explanation: High score, but flagged base_day. It must not occupy a slot in the four trips. Use on the two rest days.
destinations.why_suitable: The other two days of the six.

scoring_notes: cisano-base excluded from the four trips despite 86 because it is not a day trip.
lazise 82 lost to peschiera 84: beach + distinct fortress, and less overlap with the Bardolino harbor the family already has.
torri excluded because the ferry loop already includes it.
sirmione lost on parking math, not on taste.
venice last among headline names and still included.
